character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
Pixel art character sprite of a heavy Mega-level artillery cyborg dragon warrior inspired by BlitzGreymon, imposing wide combat stance, three-quarter front view.

Visual Design:
- Body & Build: Bulky muscular bipedal dragon humanoid framed in heavy, angular crimson-red and gunmetal-black Chrome Digizoid armor, with exposed mechanical joints and red power cables.
- Arms & Weaponry (Twin Plasma Cannons): Massive high-caliber plasma railgun cannons (Plasma Stakes) replacing standard gauntlets on both forearms, featuring heavy silver barrels, glowing yellow energy chambers, and hydraulic recoil pistons.
- Back Armament & Thrusters: Massive pair of heavy dark-crimson armor binders on the upper back housing multi-missile launcher pods, twin vertical exhaust vents spewing red lightning sparks, and a spiked armored tail.
- Head & Visor: Brutal red dragon cyber-helm with twin sharp black horns, sweeping swept-back golden crest fins, and a glowing yellow visor slit over a heavy mechanical jaw.
- Lower Body & Greaves: Reinforced crimson-and-black armored legs with heavy yellow knee guards and massive mechanical clawed stomper boots built to absorb high-impact recoil.

Style Specifications:
- 32-bit crisp RPG pixel art sprite, 64x64 or 128x128 canvas resolution.
- High-contrast metallic red and gunmetal shading, glowing yellow electric plasma effects, sharp dark pixel outlines.
- Centered full-body sprite isolated on a clean transparent background.
